description: Security check of a Gnosis Safe smart-account wallet: reads on-chain the Safe version, whether a transaction guard is set, and which modules are enabled (named, or flagged as unknown). Paid per-use via x402 (USDC on Polygon); auto-pays if REPUTA_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY is set. Only meaningful for addresses that are actually a Safe.
name: reputa_safe_check
